answer: Scale is the farm's enemy, and the bench makes scale expensive. The record that outlives the epoch is Certified baker oven temperature log with apprenticeship board confirmation, and it is written in 5-year apprenticeship, 193 supervised ovens, journeyman exam, guild dues. The mirror tells the panel who taught the hands, the sonnet tells the panel what the hands cost, and the plume tells the panel when the hands learned. A hundred would-be clones face a hundred separate bills: 53 POA and 15 minutes each, 39644 POA in all.
